case: `precondition_evaluator_kind`'s two members written in the other order -- the same two values the guard compares against -- which must not be refused.
why: The adverse case is about a field being UNTYPED. The benign case has to prove the repair did not overshoot into byte-equality on the type declaration: `deterministic` and `model` are the guard's two comparands and their order carries nothing, so an interest declaring either is admissible and a check that refused the reordering would be refusing an edit that changes no admissible value.
